# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Always add or update unit tests when implementing feature changes in this repository.
- Follow MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architecture principles when adding new features or modifying existing ones.
- Do not rely on implicit usings
- `Nullable` are both enabled in `DCSRelay.csproj` — expect nullability analysis to be on.
- Keep low cpu and memory usage in mind when implementing features
